- Integration scope: invoice ingestion + embedding-based search for cost anomalies
- Data handling: VPC-only, optional token scrubbing, 30-day KV cache retention
- Performance targets: p95 latency < 200ms for short queries at 50 qps

Next steps (proposed):
1) I’ll share a draft SOW and our standard terms to give your legal team a starting point (attached: redlines_request_v1.docx).
2) Ella / procurement to confirm timing for legal review and any procurement approvals (estimated 2–3 weeks).
3) Technical follow-up: Sofia to coordinate a short implementation kickoff if terms look good.

If you’d like, we can also prepare a condensed commercial summary for your procurement team.
